name: io.github.aashishmahajan/kube-noob
title: kube-noob
description: Kubernetes, OpenShift, ROSA HCP, Helm and RHACS audit, debugging and cited docs. No AI inside.

environmentVariables.name: KUBE_NOOB_WEB_ENABLED
environmentVariables.description: Allow allowlisted web lookups (default false: offline)

environmentVariables.name: KUBE_NOOB_CLUSTER_ENABLED
environmentVariables.description: Enable read-only live cluster tools using your kubectl/oc context (default false)

environmentVariables.name: KUBE_NOOB_OFFLINE
environmentVariables.description: Admin lock: no web, no downloads, local models only (default false)
